messages:
deploybot: scheduled online backfill 'email_normalize_hash' on users.email in change window 2025-04-02 01:30-02:30 UTC. plan: add nullable hash column, backfill in chunks, switch write path behind FF. canary 1% traffic, service pin web/user-api@v5.2.0-canary. holdpoint at 01:50 UTC. automatic abort if pg locks > 5s on >3 sessions or error_rate>0.8% for 5m. :calendar:
alex: ack. adding a hard row cap to the backfill runner: max_rows_per_minute=5000. if we need immediate throttle, use `backfill.pause` endpoint.
priya: can we also pin libsql client to 3.1.0 for canary? 3.2 had a batching regression. i'll add it to the deploy manifest. also will run schema change as non-blocking (ADD COLUMN NULL).
tom: on-call here. i'll watch replica lag, lock_waits, and commit rate. prefer chunk_size=1000 with 200ms inter-chunk sleep to smooth IO.
opsbot: preflight checks queued: - staging backfill complete <20m - no long locks on staging - replication lag < 3s - metrics dashboards created (#dash-6187654321)
alex: rollback plan drafted: 1) pause backfill runner 2) flip FF to previous variant 3) revert service pin to web/user-api@v5.1.9 4) run 'cleanup' job to set nulls back if we observe corruption 5) schedule emergency downtime if rollback job can't converge. if holdpoint hit, execute steps 1-2 and gather heap snapshot.
priya: release note snippet: "Add users.email_normalized_hash (nullable). Backfill runs online; default feature flag off. Canary pinned to web/user-api@v5.2.0-canary; db-client pinned to libsql@3.1.0. Rollback criteria: sustained lock waits or client errors >0.8%."
deploybot: manual commands: `/deploy pin web/user-api@v5.2.0-canary` and `/deploy hold 6187654321 01:50`
tom: monitoring hooks: pg_locks_waiting_count, pg_blocking_pids, replica_lag_seconds, user-api.p99, backfill.rows_per_min. alert if replica_lag >10s or pg_blocking_pids >2 for 2m.
alex: small mitigation: if we see hot writes on a specific shard, we can flip routing to degraded-write-mode for that shard only (via router config). fallback script: `scripts/degrade_writes.sh <shard>`
priya: also adding an async FK/unique post-check to run 24h after backfill completes; reduces lock blast during migration.
opsbot: tagging @tom as holdpoint owner. i'll post reminders T-30m and T-5m and open ephemeral #deploy-6187654321 in ops workspace.
deploybot: acknowledged. will emit a final healthcheck at T-5m and at holdpoint. Good luck! :rocket:
